answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving nutrients across a mountain terrace, decentralized trust crystallizes through recursive vouching. A genuine identity drifts like a gentle zephyr through validated nodes, while malicious clones vanish into the dark, sable void of unlinked peers. Because web-of-trust consensus demands quadratic staking vouchers per edge, forging sybils imposes a superlinear attacker cost that rapidly bankrupts impostors.
